title: Effect of WC-17Co content on microstructure, mechanical properties and tribological behavior of low-pressure cold sprayed tin bronze composite coating

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: Grinm Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. (Beijing, China)
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: WC-17Co powder (secondary feedstock in other blends): D10=16.3 µm, D50=30.9 µm, D90=54.0 µm; morphology described as spheroid.
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: Ultrasonic cleaning in absolute ethanol; grit blasting with polygonal Al2O3 particles (100–200 mesh)

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: DYMET 423 low-pressure cold spraying equipment (Obninsk Center for Powder Spraying, Obninsk, Russia)
experimentalProperties.Deposit_Microhardness_System: MH-5VM Vickers hardness instrument (Shanghai Hengyi Co., Ltd., China)

Experiments.Notes: Coating ID CW0. Coatings deposited by LPCS using DYMET 423; nozzle Φ6 mm × 120 mm; air pressure 0.80 MPa; gas temperature 500 °C; stand-off ~10 mm; traverse speed 30 mm/s; path spacing 1 mm; 4 layers. Deposition efficiency from Table 2; hardness values reported as HV0.3.
